notes:
Background: product team (search + answer bots) at mid-stage SaaS. Evaluated Hosted API for rapid iteration (Nov-Dec) -> strong perf; moving to Dedicated for isolation and sustained throughput.

Key quotes: "We need predictable latency at p95 <= 300ms for chat flows and <50ms for embeddings lookup cache hits." — CTO Rajiv Patel.

Security posture: org requires SOC2 Type II evidence before Dedicated contract; SSO/SAML + IdP integration mandatory; audit logs must be immutable and exportable to our SIEM; retention controls per-customer and per-route (30d default, option to set 0-365d). KMS integration or customer-managed keys (BYOK) preferred. Data residency: US + EU separate tenancy for EU customers.

POC summary: Hosted API POC (Nov 14–Dec 12) focused on embeddings and reranking for ticket routing. Results: embeddings latency median 18ms, p95 48ms; generation latency p95 ~320ms at 1–2k tokens/day workload. Cost estimate for current workload ~ $6k/month hosted.

Dedicated ask: predictable throughput for peak support hours (target sustained 60 req/s; burst to 150 req/s), SLA 99.9, runway for 6–9 months expected growth. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization to drop infra costs by ~30%.

Engagement note: AE ran demo (12/05) with SE; SE provided staging Dedicated config and sample VPC peering diagram. Security sent preliminary questionnaire 12/20. Legal flagged data residency and retention clauses.

Current tone: constructive, pragmatic. CTO is conservative — "no half-measures on audit logs". Team open to pricing banding if commit to 12-month reserved capacity.
